title: aretiastrum aretioides
intro: Aretiastrum aretioides, commonly known as the Yellow Star Flower, is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. It is a shrub-like perennial that belongs to the Asteraceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Aretiastrum aretioides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which have been found to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
